repairs.cause: The CSV importer negated every parsed amount (`amountCents: -amountCents`) under a "ledger convention" comment, but the seeder stores amounts as written and the exporter formats stored cents unchanged, so each export→import→export cycle flipped the sign of all 1000 amounts.

timeline.text: Checking the config, the trusted source, Kane and the budget.
Starting a fresh copy of the app with the trusted source loaded.
Kane is opening the source workspace and clicking Export.
Kane export: passed, downloaded the payments CSV on the Chicago payments page
Captured export (72291 bytes, sha256 743b5c404270)
Kane is creating an empty workspace to restore into.
Kane create-destination: passed, created workspace restore-1-ade617 on the local workspace site
Kane is uploading the exported file into the empty workspace.
Kane restore: passed, imported a CSV file on the restore workspace page
Kane is exporting the restored workspace.
Kane reexport: passed, downloaded the payments CSV on the payments page
Captured reexport (73289 bytes, sha256 f3c2cf6e7884)
Comparing every record against the trusted source.
source to export: All 1,000 of 1,000 rows came back unchanged
export to reexport: 1,000 of 1,000 rows came back, but amount changed in 1,000 rows
source to reexport: 1,000 of 1,000 rows came back, but amount changed in 1,000 rows
Claude Code is reading the evidence and patching the app (attempt 1 of 3).

Patch e944ed30ab10 changed src/import/import-payments.ts: The CSV importer negated every parsed amount (`amountCents: -amountCents`) under a "ledger convention" comment, but the seeder stores amounts as written and the exporter formats stored cents unchanged, so each export→import→export cycle flipped the sign of all 1000 amounts.
Restarting the patched app on fresh data and running the same Kane journey again.

Kane is exporting the restored workspace.

Captured reexport (72291 bytes, sha256 743b5c404270)
Comparing every record against the trusted source.

REPAIRED_VERIFIED: Fixed. First run: 1,000 of 1,000 rows came back, but amount changed in 1,000 rows After the patch: 1,000 of 1,000 records came back identical after export, restore and re-export.

limitations: It proves the declared fields survive one CSV export, restore and re-export on a test copy of the app. It does not certify backups or fields outside the contract.
Kane uploads the restore file to TestMu AI cloud storage before setting it on the file input. Use public or test data only.
Kane drives the browser and reports its own pass or fail. ReturnTrip decides data equality with deterministic code and never trusts a browser success toast.
Controlled defects are recreated on a demo app and labelled as such. They are not a blind benchmark.
